ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark-grey) to high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dark pigmentation dominates the central fluke and upper trailing edge; large contiguous light-grey to white regions are mapped to the lower distal sections of both lobes, punctuated by dark linear streaks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a sharp interior vertex; depth constitutes approximately 15% of the visible vertical fluke profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing boundary, with macro-level jaggedness particularly prominent on the left lobe's upper margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature beginning at the median notch, transitioning into a pronounced convex sweep towards the upwardly-curved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct, textured clusters of high-contrast white and dark circular pixel groups located on the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous dark, parallel and non-parallel linear streaks (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the light-pigmented areas of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent diagonal rake marks across both lobes and visible barnacle attachments at the trailing edge tips.
